Browser background removal: @imgly/background-removal 1.7.0, IMG.LY, AGPL-3.0. Upstream source: https://github.com/imgly/background-removal-js . Unminified package source: background-removal-source.mjs. Integration source: ../cutout-worker.js and ../cutout-engine.js. Model/runtime resources are downloaded from the library default staticimgly.com endpoint. Photos are processed locally. Rebuild with pnpm install and pnpm build:cutout.
